stopCondition: BLOCKED — PROSPECTIVE VALIDATOR HARDENING QA — P0 live topology ambiguity audit gap permits post-ambiguity prospective evidence

blockers.summary: A room can continue prospective drain after its Worker-to-page ownership has become ambiguous, until the next 10-second live topology audit.
sourceFacts: Between audits, discover_candidates is called with skip_page_ids=live_page_ids, so the already-connected page relation is intentionally omitted from relation-graph reconstruction.
Cross-page ambiguity is only acted on after discover_candidates returns ambiguity diagnostics.
After the discovery block, every remaining room is unconditionally drained and ingested as prospective evidence.
adversarialSequence: t=100: page-a / worker-shared is a valid connected room and a full topology audit has just completed.
t=101: page-b appears and is associated with the same exact worker-shared, making ownership ambiguous.
t=105: normal discovery runs inside the 10-second audit gap; page-a is skipped, so the relation graph cannot observe both page relations.
t=105: existing page-a room is not finalized and drain() still runs; returned rows can be ingested as prospective.
t>=110: a full audit can finally see both page relations and finalize before that poll's drain.
blockers.impact: Evidence generated after association became ambiguous can be attributed to the pre-existing room and can contribute to minProspectiveSignals/minProspectiveRooms/minDistinctTargets/minObservedTypes/lifecycle gates, creating a false research PASS from evidence whose ownership is no longer unique.
blockers.requiredFixProperty: Before any prospective drain/ingest, current topology must prove that each live room still has a unique Worker-to-page relation; if uniqueness is lost, censor/finalize first. No positive audit interval may leave an evidence-ingest window after the ambiguity exists.
